note: Queue tasks reference template_id+version+inputs only. Standalone until workhorse A-B-C proof lands.

templates.material_delta_rule: Only report a buyer, problem, evidence triple not already in packet store; else NO_DELTA.
templates.objective: Identify one revenue-capable workflow from existing evidence.
templates.output_schema: MUSE_REVENUE_WINNER{ BEST_CURRENT_WORKFLOW, WHY, SMALLEST_PILOT, ZERO_COST_VALIDATION, WHAT_NOT_TO_BUILD, NEXT_ACTION }

templates.material_delta_rule: Only report competitor capability changes vs last moat packet; else NO_DELTA.
templates.objective: Delta-check one named competitor against Courier differentiation.
templates.output_schema: MUSE_MOAT_DELTA{ COMPETITOR, CHANGED_CAPABILITY, VERDICT: UNIQUE|STRONGER|COMMODITIZED|UNPROVEN, EVIDENCE }

templates.material_delta_rule: Only report roadmap items removable now with existing replacement; else NO_DELTA.
templates.objective: Find roadmap work to delete rather than implement.
templates.output_schema: MUSE_WORK_ELIMINATION{ WORK_ITEM, WHY_NOT_NEEDED, EXISTING_REPLACEMENT, WORK_SAVED, SAFE_TO_DELETE_OR_DEFER, OWNER }

templates.material_delta_rule: Only propose tasks needing zero judgment; else NO_DELTA.
templates.objective: Find AI tasks replaceable by deterministic CLI.
templates.output_schema: MUSE_CLI_REPLACEMENT{ AI_TASK, WHY_AI_NOT_REQUIRED, LOCAL_REPLACEMENT, INPUT, OUTPUT, SAFETY, OWNER }

templates.material_delta_rule: Only report waste not covered by existing mechanisms; else NO_DELTA.
templates.output_schema: MUSE_COST_IMPROVEMENT{ PROBLEM, NEW_EVIDENCE, ALREADY_HANDLED, MISSING_CONTROL, DETERMINISTIC_FIX, DO_NOT_BUY }

templates.material_delta_rule: Only report lock-in not already recorded; else NO_DELTA.
templates.output_schema: MUSE_PROVIDER_DELTA{ LOCK_IN_RISK, PROVIDER, NEUTRAL_CONTRACT, CHEAPEST_FIX, CAN_DEFER, DO_NOT_BUY }

templates.material_delta_rule: Only report buyer-stated requirements with source; never invent requirements.
templates.objective: Collect enterprise/on-prem buyer requirements from evidence only.

templates.material_delta_rule: Only durable strategic insight; else NO_DELTA.
templates.output_schema: MUSE_GOAL_NETWORK{ NEW_EVIDENCE, COMMODITIZED, HARD_UNSOLVED_PROBLEM, COURIER_ASSET, FUTURE_MOAT_HYPOTHESIS, DO_NOT_BUILD_YET }

templates.material_delta_rule: Only verified-credential mechanisms with live evidence.
Only models with a paying buyer on at least one side.
